title: QA Engineer
description:
QA Engineer 
 Location: Bengaluru | Team: Engineering | Experience: 2-4 years 
 About Abhinandan Ventures An Abhinandan Lodha Enterprise: 
 (https://www.ablventures.com/): 
 Abhinandan Ventures, is a formidable collective of some of the best-of-breed, high- growth new-age 
 businesses. We back highly ambitious ideas and turn them into category- disrupting businesses built to 
 stand the test of time. 
 We are a launchpad for nascent businesses that have the potential to become a part of our eclectic mix 
 of businesses. We deploy unlevered and patient proprietary capital with a focus on value creation, 
 unconstrained by the pressures of redemption. 
 Our decentralized portfolio operates with independent CEOs and empowered leadership teams, 
 fostering a performance-driven culture that sparks value creation. This ecosystem cultivates consumer- 
 centric brands at the forefront of innovation, always pursuing excellence. Anchored in sound business 
 practices, our businesses are poised for greatness, shaping industries as they grow. 
 About Bonito Designs: 
 Bonito Designs Pvt Ltd (www.bonito.in) is one of the fastest growing Start-Ups in India in the Interior 
 Designing Industry. The Company is funded by Tomorrow Capital (www.tomorrowcapital.in) an 
 Abhinandan Ventures . The Company has its business operations in Bangalore & Mumbai and is soon 
 planning to expand to other metro cities. The Management team is committed to make this one of the 
 most aspiring brand for Indian consumers and a great place to work for employees. 
 The Company has a very conducive working environment for employees and offers fast- track growth 
 opportunities for deserving & committed professionals. 
 About the Role 
 Were looking for a QA Engineer who treats quality as engineering, not a checklist. Youll own 
 testing across our product ecosystem, including internal platforms, customer-facing apps, 
 integrations, and AI-powered products were actively building, across both manual and 
 automation. 
 This isnt a role for someone who just executes test cases. Its for QA engineers who think like 
 users, break things on purpose, automate what hurts to repeat, and care about what ships to 
 production. 
 What We Absolutely Need 
 These are non-negotiable. Without these, the role wont work, regardless of years of experience or 
 tool familiarity. 
 Thinks like a user, tests like an adversary. You dont just verify happy paths. You hunt 
 edge cases, race conditions, weird inputs, and the scenarios no one wrote a ticket for. 
 Strong fundamentals in both manual and automation. You write clear test plans and test 
 cases, and you also know when something deserves to be automated and how to do it well. 
 
 
 Owns quality end to end. You dont throw bugs over the wall. You reproduce cleanly, 
 isolate root cause where you can, and partner with engineers to make sure fixes actually fix 
 things. 
 ¢ Solid grasp of APIs and web fundamentals. You can read a request/response, debug from 
 logs and network traces, and understand whats happening under the UI, not just whats on 
 it. 
 ¢ SQL is second nature. You can query a database to verify state, validate data, and 
 investigate issues without needing a developer to do it for you. 
 ¢ Proactively raises risks and gaps. You flag missing acceptance criteria, untested scenarios, 
 and risky releases before they become production incidents. 
 ¢ Tool-flexible, but deep in at least one. Frameworks come and go. What matters is whether 
 you understand testing principles well enough to pick up whatever stack we use. 
 ¢ Learns fast. New product, unfamiliar domain, unfamiliar codebase, and you ramp up 
 quickly and start finding real issues. 
 What Youll Do 
 ¢ Design and execute manual test plans for new features, regressions, and integrations 
 ¢ Build and maintain automated test suites for web (UI + API) and grow coverage over time 
 ¢ Test APIs thoroughly: contracts, edge cases, error handling, performance 
 ¢ Partner with developers and PMs during design and development, not just after 
 ¢ Write clear, reproducible bug reports and drive them to closure 
 ¢ Help shape our QA practices, processes, and quality bar as the team grows 
 General Expectations 
 Writes clean, maintainable automation code. Documents test plans and decisions so others can 
 build on them. Communicates clearly with engineers, PMs, and stakeholders. Raises the overall 
 quality bar through how you work, not just what you test. 
 Tools & Stack 
 On the automation side, we expect comfort with at least one modern web automation framework 
 ( Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium ) and one API testing tool ( Postman, REST Assured, or 
 similar ). Familiarity with SQL is essential; we work primarily with PostgreSQL, and also 
 MongoDB and ClickHouse. Exposure to CI pipelines and integrating tests into them is a plus. 
 The specific tool youve used matters less than how well you understand testing. If your 
 fundamentals are solid, youll pick up our stack quickly. 
 Good to Have 
 ¢ Experience with performance or load testing (JMeter, k6, or similar) 
 ¢ Exposure to mobile app testing (iOS/Android) 
 
 
 ¢ Experience testing AI/LLM-based features and handling non-deterministic outputs 
 ¢ Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar) 
 ¢ Basic scripting in JavaScript, Python, or Ruby 
 Why This Role 
 Youll own quality across systems that directly run a fast-growing interior design business, not 
 throwaway projects. The scope is broad, the ownership is real, and youll have the space to shape 
 how QA works here as the team scales.

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior QA Engineer with 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Manual and Automation Testing. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in software quality assurance, test planning, test execution, defect management, API and database testing, and automation framework development. The candidate should have a strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and modern QA practices. Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright is expected, with Playwright preferred. The role will involve working closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality, reliable, and scalable software releases. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Test Planning Strategy: Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to define test strategies, scope, effort, timelines, and test coverage. Manual Testing: Design and execute comprehensive test cases and scenarios covering functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and UAT testing. Test Documentation: Create and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, test data, test execution reports, and other QA documentation. Automation Testing: Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard automation tools and frameworks. Automation Framework Development: Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable and reusable automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, or Appium. Regression Smoke Automation: Automate regression and smoke test suites to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and release cycles. Defect Management: Identify, document, track, prioritize, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. API Testing: Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI, and Swagger/OpenAPI. Database Testing: Validate database records, data integrity, data flow, and backend processes using SQL and relational databases. End-to-End Testing: Validate complete business workflows across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems. CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices. Quality Risk Management: Perform risk-based testing, identify potential quality risks, and recommend appropriate testing strategies and mitigation approaches. Performance Optimization: Analyze test execution and automation results, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency. Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. Release Validation: Support release and deployment validation activities and ensure software meets defined quality standards before production release. Quality Improvement: Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards, tools, frameworks, and best practices. Technical Contribution: Participate in code reviews, test strategy discussions, technical discussions, and automation roadmap planning. Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers and contribute to building overall team capabilities. 
 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Software Testing and Quality Assurance. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) . Strong experience in both Manual and Automation Testing . Hands-on experience with one or more automation tools such as: Selenium WebDriver Cypress Playwright (Preferred) TestNG / JUnit Cucumber / BDD Appium Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language such as Java, Python, or JavaScript . Strong knowledge of SQL and database testing. Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI, or Swagger/OpenAPI . Experience working with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Git, Maven, or Gradle . Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, HP ALM/Quality Center, or Azure DevOps . Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments . Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills 
 Hands-on experience with Playwright and modern automation frameworks. Experience developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner . Experience testing Microservices Architecture . Strong knowledge of API automation frameworks. Understanding of Security and Accessibility Testing . Experience with healthcare domain applications, including HIPAA, HL7, EHR/EMR, Claims, Eligibility, or Revenue Cycle . Experience with FHIR-based integrations . Exposure to MCP and AI-assisted workflow testing . Familiarity with modern CI/CD and continuous testing practices. Experience with test automation reporting, monitoring, and quality metrics.
